notes: Season 11.0: Doomsday adds Nightcrawler (Strategist, 275 HP) as the game's 55th playable hero; Dracula is announced but not yet playable.
No hero removals, role changes or Team-Up re-routes: all 54 carried-over heroes keep the same two outgoing partners as 20261022-season-10-5-2.

Nightcrawler's Team-Ups are Demon Disciple (partner Magik) and Protective Siblings (partner Rogue). Both are directional Nightcrawler edges; neither Magik nor Rogue lists Nightcrawler among their own two loadouts, so no reciprocal pair is declared.

Official hero page for Nightcrawler was not published before the 2026-11-13 09:00 UTC launch, so ability text comes from marvelrivals.gg and the wiki and numeric stat blocks are left empty rather than guessed. Re-run scripts/fetch_hero_details.py after launch to replace them with official values.
Team-Up relationships are directional: each active hero has exactly two outgoing partners.
Generated combinations are derived from heroes.json and teamups.json.
